halt_mult_1401.note: Sec.1401: residual halt probability relative to current law. The Senate-passed text adds exception (F), action 'taken pursuant to any applicable law or regulation', which could cover stop-work orders like 2025's (issued under existing regulations); high = the exception swallows the rule, low = courts read it narrowly
